access_conditions.split-training-wire: Captured training-phase forward/backward wires at the split point; public calibration partition; pretrained public head only (final victim head not granted); query budgets matched across defenses.

meta.description: Adversary-conditioned assurance matrix: defense x attacker access x measured leakage x utility cost x evidence strength. Per-row measurements only — no universal risk score and no maturity model; the current evidence does not validate either.

evidence_ladder.meaning: Fixture/synthetic batteries (e.g. replica-integrity fixtures, view-privacy synthetic de-mixing). Engineering checks on synthetic data; positives do not falsify a deployed defense.
Live in-repo channels exercised end to end (capture/transport/recovery plumbing). Demonstrates mechanism, not measured leakage against a defended target.

Defended development pilot over trained defenders: paired defense-minus-none seed differences with percentile bootstrap CIs, utility deltas, failures-and-nulls accounting. Development tier; conditional on a fixed article sample; not a confirmatory claim.
Frozen crossed-bootstrap study under the v2 protocol (crossed document/run bootstrap with multiplicity correction). Protocol frozen; evidence counts at this level only once executed.

meta.fail_closed_policy: Rows with missing leakage or utility fields are emitted as INCOMPLETE, never dropped or imputed.
